title: Provider Infrastructure: SSE Parser, Registries, Model Catalog, Stream API & Utilities
description:
Implement the provider infrastructure layer from docs/plans/01-ai-core.md.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Sections: §5 (Provider & Model Registries), §6 (Model Catalog), §7 (Stream Entry Points), §8 (Thinking Utilities), §12 (SSE Parser)

Key deliverables:
- internal/ai/sse package: Scanner struct, Event struct, SSE protocol implementation (comments, BOM, multi-line data, event delimiters per spec)
- Provider interface (API(), Stream(), StreamSimple())
- Provider registry: RegisterProvider, GetProvider, GetProviders, UnregisterProviders, ClearProviders (sync.RWMutex, sourceID-based bulk unregistration)
- Model struct with ModelCost, ModelCompat (provider-specific compat flags)
- Model registry: RegisterModel, GetModel, GetModels, GetModelProviders, ClearModels, deepCopyModel (clone Headers map, Input slice, Compat pointer)
- Embedded model catalog: catalog.json via go:embed, init() loader
- CalculateCost ($/million tokens arithmetic)
- ModelsEqual, SupportsXHigh utilities
- Stream entry points: Stream, StreamSimple, Complete, CompleteSimple, errorStream helper
- Thinking utilities: BuildBaseOptions, ClampReasoning, AdjustMaxTokensForThinking (budget math with defaults and overrides)
- Unit tests for all components
- Test harness tests: P3 (CalculateCost consistency with rapid), P7 (model registry mutation isolation), P9 (registry thread-safety, 50 goroutines × 1000 ops), S2 (registry stress under contention), F1 (SSE parser fuzz), B2 (SSE parsing benchmark, target <100μs for 100 events), B6 (CalculateCost benchmark, target <100ns), B7 (model lookup benchmark, target <200ns), Sec2 (SSE resource limits)
- All tests must pass with -race flag

See Implementation Guide §Interface Contracts for Provider interface contract.

References:
- Plan: docs/plans/01-ai-core.md §5, §6, §7, §8, §12
- Test harness: docs/plans/01-ai-core-test-harness.md §1 (P3, P7, P9), §3 (F1), §4 (S2), §5 (B2, B6, B7), §7 (Sec2)
- Depends on: Core Types & EventStream (aiag-qkh.1)
